Flow.description: Keeps a synced quote's pricing current when its line items change after sync. Fires on a QuoteLineItem of a synced quote (Quote.IsSyncing = true) only when a pricing INPUT changes (new line, quantity, or product) — never on price-output fields, so the reprice engine's own price writes cannot re-trigger it. Skips Amend quotes (Instant Pricing + Amendment Studio Reprice All own that path; a second FORCE reprice races the Quote Line Editor). Delegates to RLM_RepriceQuoteInvocable, which dedupes by quote and reprices asynchronously.
Flow.interviewLabel: RLM Reprice Quote On Line Change {!$Flow.CurrentDateTime}
Flow.label: RLM Reprice Quote On Line Change

start.filterFormula: AND( {!$Record.Quote.IsSyncing}, TEXT({!$Record.Quote.OriginalActionType}) <> "Amend", OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Quantity}), ISCHANGED({!$Record.Product2Id}) ) )
